description: Submit completed work for review. Transitions in_progress -> in_review. Requires the commit SHA, the files you changed and the named tests that prove the criterion (each test name should start with the criterion's code, for example `[AC-042] rejects an empty title`). A passing local run does not finish the criterion: CI (or a person) decides, and only a passing CI run marks it verified.

baseSha.description: Commit SHA the work was based on (7+ chars)

changedFiles.description: Every file the work changed (at least one)

diffUrl.description: Optional URL to view the diff (PR link or compare URL)

gitSha.description: 7+ char commit SHA of the work

notes.description: Optional notes for the reviewer (max 2000 chars)

specSeq.description: The spec sequence number from the context pack you built against, so a later spec change can be detected

tests.description: The named tests that prove the criterion (at least one)

acCodes.description: Criterion codes this test proves, like AC-042

name: vibemap_submit_for_review
